pages.text: $(bold)Dodge$() is action for avoiding bullets or arrows. You can quickly move short distance. $(br)However be careful with cool time!

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: $(list)Press the back, left or right movement key twice(impossible with forward key)$(list)No key is bound to Dodge($(k:parcool.Dodge)) by default. Bind one yourself and you can dodge forward too
$(bold)Turn On / Off$()$(br2)You can turn this action on or off right here.
